Massive Ravana effigies burned in Surajpur and Bahadurgarh Dussehra

During Dussehra celebrations, Surajpur burned a 60‑foot tall Ravana effigy along with effigies of Kumbhakarna and Meghnath, while the city echoed with chants of "Jai Shri Ram"; Bahadurgarh burned a 50‑foot tall Ravana effigy, both events forming part of the festival.
